reviewResult.summary: Synthetic example: the browser result validator rejects a flaky owner journey, and health checks and lane budgets need follow-up. No check ran for this fixture.

findings.message: Synthetic failure example only: the browser result validator rejects the run because an owner acceptance journey passed only on retry.
No application health or readiness endpoint exists; until blog-0045.12 lands, production verification has only the root-page smoke, which checks no dependency.
Direction browser budgets run only through their lane Playwright configs, which CI does not execute; report them as local checks or wire them into a gate.
Choose the server error-reporting sink and its redaction contract before the first production deployment.
